description: HOW LONG GA4 KEEPS EVENT- AND USER-LEVEL DATA. The default is 2 months, which silently caps every exploration and funnel at the last two months; standard reports are unaffected. action:'get' reads it; 'set' changes eventDataRetention / userDataRetention (2 or 14 months on a standard property; 26, 38, 50 for event data on Analytics 360 only) and resetUserDataOnNewActivity. RAISING applies to data already collected. LOWERING DELETES the older data at Google's next monthly run and cannot be undone, so it answers needsConfirm first — show the user, get a yes, then confirm:true. Read back. Free.

confirm.description: required when the change SHORTENS retention, which deletes data

eventDataRetention.description: months: 2 or 14 (26/38/50 Analytics 360 only), or the enum e.g. FOURTEEN_MONTHS

property.description: NUMERIC GA4 property id, from list_analytics_properties

resetUserDataOnNewActivity.description: true = a user's data retention window restarts each time that user shows new activity

name: analytics_data_retention
title: GA4 data retention
